parole.significato: A member of a First Nation group based on the west coast of Vancouver Island in British Columbia, Canada.
parole.testo: From Nootka ʕaaḥuusʔatḥ, from ʕaaḥuus (“Ahous, village near Ahous Bay on the western coast of Vargas Island”) + -ʔatḥ (“people”).

parole.significato: Tseshaht First Nation spelling of Tseshaht.
parole.testo: From Nootka c̓išaaʔatḥ, from c̓išaa + -ʔatḥ (“people of”).

parole.significato: klootchman: woman, wife (especially if Native American).
parole.testo: Either a shortening of klootchman, or simply from the Nootka łuuč (“female”); that is, from the first part of that word without the addition of the second part.

parole.significato: A member of the Nuu-chah-nulth people, an indigenous people from Vancouver Island, Canada
parole.testo: From Nootka nuutkaa (“go around”), a direction given to European explorers reaching Nootka Sound, subsequently misapplied to the location and group.

parole.significato: A people indigenous to Vancouver Island in western Canada.
parole.testo: From Nootka nuučaan̓uł (“all along the mountains”).

parole.significato: ʕaaḥuusʔatḥ First Nation spelling of Keltsmaht.
ʕaaḥuusʔatḥ First Nation spelling of Qwatswiaht.

parole.testo: From Nootka c̓išaaʔatḥ, from c̓išaa (“Ts’ishaa, Benson Island in Barkley Sound”) + -ʔatḥ (“people of”).

parole.testo: Unadapted borrowing from Nootka ƛaʔuukʷiʔatḥ, from ƛaʔuukʷi + -ʔatḥ.
